import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_42/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_42/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'Store'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Store", how="inner")

# Group by StoreType and sum Weekly_Sales from Source0
grouped = joined.groupby("StoreType", as_index=False)["Weekly_Sales"].sum()

# Rename the aggregated column to 'Store' as per target schema
grouped = grouped.rename(columns={"Weekly_Sales": "Store"})

# Ensure the types match the target schema: StoreType as string, Store as integer
grouped["StoreType"] = grouped["StoreType"].astype(str)
grouped["Store"] = grouped["Store"].astype(int)

# Write the final result to the target path
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_42/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_42/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_42/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Store column (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='Store', right_on='Store')

# Group by StoreType (string, leftmost key in target), aggregate Store by min to get unique Store per StoreType
result = joined.groupby('StoreType', as_index=False).agg({'Store': 'min'})

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_42/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
